title: The Island That Was Never on Any Map
description: A pirate crew finds an island that no map has ever shown. Three days later, it is gone.

scenes.title: not on any map
scenes.voice: In 1743, a pirate crew found an island that was not on any map. Three days later, it was gone.

scenes.title: forty men
scenes.voice: Forty men rowed ashore at dawn. Only nine came back, and none of them agreed on what they saw.

scenes.title: three stories
scenes.voice: One said the sand was warm like a living thing. One said the trees moved against the wind. One never spoke again.

scenes.title: open water
scenes.voice: When they sailed back with a second ship, they found open water. No island. No wreck. Not even birds.

scenes.title: Follow for part two
scenes.voice: Was it a mirage, a trick of the tide, or something the sea wanted to keep? Follow for part two.
